Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Ms. Neeta Singh Chandel, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Arvind Kumar Pandey,
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.
2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
322 of 2022, under Sections 41, 411, 413, 414, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 484, 120-B I.P.C., registered at Police Station Vibhuti Khand, District Lucknow.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 30.05.2023 by the Station House Officer, Police Station Vibhuti Khand, Lucknow against 4 persons, not including the applicant, alleging that on the basis of an information received from a mukhbir, the police found four named accused persons in two car in which they were sitting and 4 other cars parked there.
In the custodial statement the named accused persons implicated six other persons, including the applicant as the person who were also involved in commission of the offence.

1 their pointing out 14 other vehicles were recovered from an open place.

sentences.text: 4. In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The applicant's involvement in seven other cases has been disclosed in para 19 of the affidavit in all of which the applicant has been implicated after his arrest.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that no independent person has witnessed the alleged recovery.

6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.
7.

Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant is languishing in jail since 10.05.2023 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
8. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
